tools.name: simpleinventory_get_account
tools.description: Show the organization and API key this server uses, with the key's scopes (read, write). Good first call to check the connection. Simple Inventory API: GET /me.

tools.name: simpleinventory_list_folders
tools.description: List the organization's folders with their IDs and full paths. Use a folder ID as folderId when you create or move an item. Simple Inventory API: GET /folders.

tools.name: simpleinventory_list_items
tools.description: List active (not archived) items with quantity, prices, SKU and folder. Search by name or SKU with search, or find one SKU with sku. To read every item, pass after=0 and then each response's pagination.nextAfter until hasMore is false. Simple Inventory API: GET /items.

tools.name: simpleinventory_get_item
tools.description: Get one item by ID or SKU, including archived items (archived: true). A variant group also returns its variations. Simple Inventory API: GET /items/{identifier}.

tools.name: simpleinventory_list_recent_events
tools.description: List the newest events of one type (stock changes, low or out-of-stock alerts, item created, updated or archived), newest first. Useful to test a webhook handler with real data. Simple Inventory API: GET /events.

tools.name: simpleinventory_create_item
tools.description: Create a standalone item, as adding it in the app would. It counts toward the plan's item limit and needs an organization that is not past due. Simple Inventory API: POST /items.

tools.name: simpleinventory_update_item
tools.description: Change an item's details (not its stock). Send only the fields to change. null clears a field, except name. Archived items cannot be changed. Simple Inventory API: PATCH /items/{identifier}.

tools.name: simpleinventory_change_stock
tools.description: Set, add to, or remove from one item's stock. operation "set" (default) makes stock exactly quantity; "increment" adds; "decrement" removes and stops at 0. Pass idempotencyKey so a retry cannot apply twice. Simple Inventory API: PATCH /items/{identifier}/quantity.

tools.name: simpleinventory_bulk_update_stock
tools.description: Change stock on 1-100 items in one request. Give each change an id or a sku. Each change applies on its own, so one failure does not stop the rest. A 200 reply can still list failed changes in errors: check success and errors. Simple Inventory API: POST /items/bulk-update.

tools.name: simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook
tools.description: Send one event type to a URL you own, as a signed HTTP POST (HMAC-SHA256). The reply returns the signing secret only in the app (Settings → Integrations → Webhooks). Subscribing twice returns the existing subscription. Limit 50 API subscriptions per organization. Simple Inventory API: POST /hooks.

tools.name: simpleinventory_unsubscribe_webhook
tools.description: Remove a subscription made with simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook, with its delivery log. Webhooks added in the app are not removed here. Simple Inventory API: DELETE /hooks/{id}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: simpleinventory_bulk_update_stock · Private data: simpleinventory_get_account, simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook · Public sink: simpleinventory_list_recent_events, simpleinventory_create_item, simpleinventory_update_item, simpleinventory_bulk_update_stock, simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook, simpleinventory_unsubscribe_webhook · Destructive: simpleinventory_change_stock, simpleinventory_unsubscribe_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: simpleinventory_bulk_update_stock · Private data: simpleinventory_get_account, simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook · Public sink: simpleinventory_list_recent_events, simpleinventory_create_item, simpleinventory_update_item, simpleinventory_bulk_update_stock, simpleinventory_subscribe_webhook, simpleinventory_unsubscribe_webhook · Destructive: simpleinventory_change_stock, simpleinventory_unsubscribe_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
